exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "For the sake of/In order to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ために matches "For the sake of/In order to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ために.
exercises.explanation: Expresses purpose or reason: "in order to" or "for the sake of."
